newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Australian bond spreads in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads in narrow range.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to other dollar bloc bonds held to a fairly narrow range after Thursday's strong rally in U.S. Treasuries helped to stabilise markets, traders said.

Strong demand for the last leg of the U.S. refunding auctions, US$10.0 billion of 30-year bonds, helped to offset concerns over the state of the Japanese market which sent a shock wave through forex and debt markets in Asian time on Thursday.
Even New Zealand debt, which saw a much stronger than expected September quarter labour force report, held reasonably steady.
Meanwhile, the local yield curve was slightly flatter with the short-end remaining pegged at its recent yield lows and much in line with current 6.50 percent official interest rates.
